detectorId.description: Unique identifier of this detector within its owning system.
detectorId.title: ObjectId

typeId.description: Unique identifier for a detector type (loop, radar, ANPR, ...).
typeId.title: TypeId

creationDate.description: When this definition record was created.

location.description: Physical location of the detector. Optional.

transportLinkId.description: Transport link this detector monitors or sits on. Optional.
transportLinkId.title: ObjectId

linkDistanceMetres.description: Distance along that transport link, in metres. Optional.

networkLinkId.description: Network link the detector stands on. At most one of this and networkPathId. Optional.
networkLinkId.title: ObjectId

networkPathId.description: Network path the detector stands on. At most one of this and networkLinkId. Optional.
networkPathId.title: ObjectId

participantId.description: System that owns this detector definition. Often implicit from context.
participantId.title: ParticipantId

originatingParticipantId.description: Identifier of the upstream system that originally created this object (comparable to the UML DataSourceTypeId).
originatingParticipantId.title: ParticipantId

originatingObjectId.description: Identifier of this object on the originating (upstream) system. Enables cross-system traceability.
originatingObjectId.title: ObjectId

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.
